info.title: Emulanders Portal
info.author: joaoHypo
info.description: Skylanders Joy-Con physical dumper, clone engine & figure manager
info.details:
Emulanders Portal is a standalone full-screen manager for Skylanders on Nintendo Switch.

Features:
- Joy-Con Physical Tag Dumper (nfp:user)
- 1:1 Exact & New Identity Figure Cloning Engine
- Interactive Screenshot Cropper for custom figure portraits
- Sandboxed SD figure file manager with lazy thumbnails
- OTA Asset Pack and Dump Downloaders
- Full English & Portuguese support with customizable color themes.

changelog:
v1.0.0
- Initial release for Nintendo Switch Homebrew App Store!
- Native Joy-Con physical figure scanner and 1KB Mifare dumper.
- Figure Cloning Engine with UID randomization and sector trailer recalculation.
- Interactive crop tool with Switch Album integration.
- Bilingual localization (EN / PT-BR) and docked controller navigation.
